selection_rule: padj < threshold in at least one of the first plate group's rows
drug_inclusion: every drug with a (line, drug, dose) triple on two or more plates
dose_handling: held fixed: a condition is a (line, drug, dose) triple and the split is between that triple's plates
split_rule: plates sorted by id as text within each (line, drug, dose) triple, assigned alternately
weighting: the declared ceilings are the dose-level rows of rung0_dose_strata.csv, each against nulls drawn at its own dose; this row's mean weighs every scored triple once and is reported, not divided by
